description:
Returns every change between two contract snapshots, classed as breaking, compatible or cosmetic, with the rule that decided each. Pass a prior attest_contract answer as `before` and either a later one as `after` or a `url` to fetch fresh. Both hashes are computed from the snapshot content; a hash supplied with a snapshot is checked against it and a mismatch is reported, never trusted. Nothing is stored between calls: the caller holds the history. With both snapshots it makes no request and needs no line; with `url` it makes the three requests attest_contract makes, so call it on a line: a call cut for time returns nothing.
$0.000001 per millisecond on a line.
Paid, on a line. With no wallet code, ZEAM :: Pass buys the time and opens the line for you, with a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet: https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay
Example: {"url":"https://mcp.zeamprism.com/mcp","before":{"snapshot":[]}}

after.description: optional object — a later `contract` answer; omit to fetch from `url`.

before.description: object — a prior `contract` answer from this shelf (or its `snapshot` array). Its `hash` field is recomputed from the snapshot, not trusted.

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

url.description: optional string — fetch a fresh contract from this MCP endpoint as `after`.

name: attest_drift

anyOf.description: hash computed from the content of `after`
hash computed from the content of `before`

every request made, in the order sent: method, url, request headers of note, status, ms; a request that drew no answer has status 0 and its error, a redirect followed is listed in redirects, and a request still unanswered when a report was cut has unanswered: true
for each snapshot that came with a hash: supplied, computed, matches
true when the two hashes computed here from the snapshot content are equal
